title: Proceratium silaceum
extract: Proceratium silaceum is a species of ant in the family Formicidae.

title: Iron(III) sulfate
extract: Iron(III) sulfate or ferric sulfate is a family of inorganic compounds with the formula Fe2(SO4)3(H2O)n. A variety of hydrates are known, including the most commonly encountered form of "ferric sulfate". Solutions are used in dyeing as a mordant and as a coagulant for industrial wastes. Solutions of ferric sulfate are also used in the processing of aluminum and steel.

title: Baggio–Yoshinari syndrome
extract: Baggio–Yoshinari syndrome (BYS), formerly known as the Brazilian Lyme disease-like illness (BLDLI) and Brazilian Human Borreliosis, is an anthropozoonotic infectious disease of infectious-reactional character transmitted by bites of ticks from Amblyomma, Rhipicephalus and Dermacentor genera, that clinically resembles the Lyme Disease (LD) seen in the northern hemisphere. It is postulated to be caused by mutant Borrelia burgdorferi sensu lato spirochetes that assumed atypical pleomorphic forms and latent behavior in an attempt to adapt to the Brazilian ecosystem, explaining many particularities of the condition relative to the classical Lyme Disease, such as being transmitted by ticks others than those within the Ixodes ricinus complex, the difficulty culturing the etiological agent in traditional medium (BSK-II) and the poor growing of the spirochetes in atypical medium (SP-4), the frequent reactivations due to evading and surviving antibiotic treatment and eliciting low and transient immune response to Borrelia burgdorferi sensu lato antigens because of the hiding from the immune system. The pleomorphic forms are thought to include round bodies resembling Chlamydia, non spiralled spirochete-like forms, blebs and cell wall deficient variants resembling Mycoplasma as seen in dark field microscopy and electron field microscopy searching bacteria in the blood of patients. Spirochete-like structures are seen in around 90% of the patients when analyzing their peripheral blood in dark field microscopy.

title: Mike Pieciak
extract: Michael Sullivan Pieciak is an American politician from Vermont. A member of the Democratic Party, Pieciak has served as Vermont State Treasurer since January 2023.

title: UFC BJJ 2
extract: UFC BJJ 2: Tackett vs. Canuto was a submission grappling event produced by UFC Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. The event was held at the UFC Apex in Las Vegas, Nevada, United States, on July 31, 2025 and was streamed live on YouTube.

title: Jakob von Washington
extract: Baron Jacobus von Washington was a lieutenant general in the Bavarian Army and a distant relative of US President George Washington. Born in The Hague, Netherlands, he was christened James Washington. Most of his adult life was shaped by his participation in wars for and against Napoleonic France and his service to Ludwig I of Bavaria.

title: Mad River Mountain
description: Ski resort in Ohio, United States
extract: Mad River Mountain is a ski and snowboard resort in Valley Hi, Ohio, United States. The elevation of Mad River Mountain is 1,460 feet (450 m) with a vertical drop of 300 ft (91 m), and it has a ski season that runs from approximately mid-December through mid-March. The resort, which opened in 1962 as Valley Hi Ski Area, is owned by EPR Properties and operated by Vail Resorts, who bought the resort from Peak Resorts in 2019.

title: Richmond Hill South
description: Federal electoral district in Ontario, Canada
extract: Richmond Hill South is a federal electoral district in Ontario, Canada, that has been represented in the House of Commons of Canada since 2004.

title: Jovan Hadži-Vasiljević
description: Serbian historian, ethnographer, journalist and writer
extract: Jovan Hadži-Vasiljević was a Serbian historian, ethnographer, journalist and writer.

title: Accord Pond
extract: Accord Pond is a 100-acre (0.40 km2) reservoir in Hingham, Norwell and Rockland, Massachusetts. The reservoir is located off Route 228 at its terminus with Route 3. The reservoir is visible from Route 3 northbound at Exit 14, the Route 228 off-ramp. The reservoir is a Class A source of water supply for the town of Hingham and Hull Ma. The outflow of the reservoir is Accord Brook, a tributary of the Weir River.

title: Ayribobo
extract: Ayribobo or Aýrybaba, officially named the Great Saparmyrat Turkmenbashi Peak in Turkmenistan since 2004, is a mountain in Central Asia. At 3,138 metres (10,295 ft) Aýrybaba is the highest mountain in Turkmenistan. It is located in the Köýtendag Range of the Pamir-Alay chain in the southeast of Turkmenistan on the Uzbekistani border.

title: Dora Akunyili
extract: Dora Nkem Akunyili was a Nigerian pharmacist and politician who served as the director-general of National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) of Nigeria from 2001 to 2008.

title: Dorothy Cottrell
extract: Ida Dorothy Ottley Cottrell was an Australian writer. Born in Picton, she contracted infantile paralysis as a child and spent the rest of her life in a wheelchair. Cottrell married Walter Mackenzie Cottrell on 23 May 1922. Her first novel, The Singing Gold, was published in 1928. She wrote a story Wilderness Orphan (1936) which was the basis for the feature film Orphan of the Wilderness (1936). She lived for a time in the US and also worked as an artist and cartoonist.

title: Philadelphia Commercial Museum
extract: The Philadelphia Commercial Museum was established in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania in 1895. Its permanent home was a neo-classical building situated at 34th Street and Civic Center Blvd, erected as part of the 1899 National Export Exposition. The museum had business offices at 332 South Fourth Street.

title: Iglesia de Santa Ana (Santiago de Chile)
extract: The Iglesia de Santa Ana is a Catholic church in downtown Santiago de Chile. It is located at the northwest corner of Catedral and San Martín streets. The church was declared as a National Monument of Chile in 1970, within the category of Historic Monuments. Santa Ana metro station is named after the church.

title: Grande Seca
extract: The Grande Seca, or the Brazilian drought of 1877–1878, was the largest and most devastating drought in Brazilian history. It caused the deaths of between 400,000 and 500,000 people. Of the 800,000 people who lived in the affected Northeastern region, around 120,000 migrated to the Amazon while 68,000 migrated to other parts of Brazil.

title: 7's Football League
extract: The 7's Football League is a seven-a-side football league in the Philippines. Established in 2018, the league already had four seasons. It has a two-tiered men's division, a women's division, and youth divisions. The league is an open tournament with participation from representative sides of the domestic football competition, the Philippines Football League.

title: Motorchuna
extract: The Motorchuna is a river in Yakutia, Russia. It is a left tributary of the Lena with a length of 423 kilometres (263 mi). Its drainage basin area is 9,250 square kilometres (3,570 mi2). Since its river basin is uninhabited, the Motorchuna is one of the most untouched rivers in Yakutia; the waters are clean and there is abundant wildlife.

title: Sage Derby
extract: Sage Derby is a variety of Derby cheese that is mild, mottled green and semi-hard, and has a sage flavour. The colour is from sage and sometimes other colouring added to the curds, producing a marbling effect and a subtle herb flavour. The colour is formed either by mixing sage leaves into the curd before it is pressed or by the addition of "green curd" from green corn or spinach juice. In the latter case, the flavour has to be created with colourless sage extract. Parsley, spinach and marigold leaves, bruised and steeped before use, can also be included instead of the sage leaves. It is aged for one to three months.

title: Franco Cozzo
extract: Franco Cozzo was an Italian-Australian businessman. After moving to Melbourne from Sicily in 1955, Cozzo became known for his television advertisements, in which he would speak in English, Greek, and Italian. He later produced Australia's first non-English TV show, Carosello, which was broadcast in Italian.
